name: Trust & Will Online Estate Planning

price.headline: Will: $199. Trust: $499 for individuals, $599 for couples.
price.note: Annual membership ($19/year) for ongoing updates included

key_facts.label: Documents
key_facts.value: Will, revocable living trust, healthcare directive, financial power of attorney

key_facts.label: Attorney review
key_facts.value: Not included; this is a self-service platform

pros: Straightforward interview-style process takes about 20 minutes
State-specific documents reviewed by estate planning attorneys
Affordable compared to hiring an attorney ($1,000 to $3,000 for a trust)
cons: Not a substitute for attorney advice on complex estates
Annual fee required to update documents after the first year
best_for: people with straightforward estates who want documents done quickly
parents who need a will and guardian designation
skip_if: your estate is complex — business interests, a blended family, or significant assets; hire an estate attorney
rating_reason: One of the cleaner online will and trust platforms. The attorney-reviewed state documents add credibility. Not a full substitute for legal advice.
